article.title: Providence just voted to divest from Israel following a campaign that should serve as a model for the country
article.author: Maxime Pitchon
article.content: Providence, RI, made history as the first U.S. city to pass binding legislation to divest from Israel at the ballot box. Our victory can serve as a model for divestment campaigns nationwide.
